Under the contract, the University leased its utility system to the Concessionaire (SPUPI) for a 50 year term and agreed to a Concession requiring the University to pay a Utility Fee to the Concessionaire who will provide utilities to the University.  The agreement also requires the University to use the Concessionaire for construction of all Utility System Capital Expenditure projects during for the 50 year term.  The transaction is purely commercial, there are no restrictions or conditions on University faculty or students, nor any affecting University curricular or research programming.  The Concessionaire is affiliated with two foreign sources (Sacyr SA: Spain and Plenary Group: Australia).  This report addresses the affiliation with Sacyr SA (Spain).
